## 🔍 What is SLR-Suite?

**SLR-Suite** is an open, modular and reproducible research infrastructure designed to conduct  
**Systematic Literature Reviews (SLR)** in an **end-to-end**, **transparent**, and **automation-friendly** manner.

---

## 🚀 Core Workflow

- Data acquisition and preprocessing  
- Screening and eligibility filtering  
- Bibliometric analysis  
- VOSviewer export and network modeling  
- TCCM matrix construction  
- Thematic evolution analysis  
- Citation impact analysis  
- SPAR-based future research agenda generation

---
